name: notification-stack
title: Notification Stack
description: Expand the stack or swipe a notification away
useCases: On a team dashboard, a teammate reviews stacked build notifications and dismisses the ones they have read.
In an activity center, the app updates notifications with stable IDs while the user works through the remaining cards.
task: Expand the stack or swipe a notification away
behavior: For structured notifications, pass notifications with stable IDs. onDismiss receives the dismissed title.
